levels.name: Recognise
levels.evidence: Learner can identify safe and inclusive school spaces in the chapter context.

levels.name: Explain
levels.evidence: Learner can explain safe and inclusive school spaces and connect it to plants and animals around school without copying source wording.

levels.name: Apply
levels.evidence: Learner can use roles in a school community in a familiar new situation.

levels.name: Transfer
levels.evidence: Learner can solve or explain an unfamiliar situation using several ideas from Our School — A Happy Place and justify the response.

levels.name: Create
levels.evidence: Learner can create a new example, question, model, investigation or explanation based on Our School — A Happy Place.

progressionRule: Move upward only when the learner demonstrates the current level independently and can explain the reasoning.
